Commentary.Commentary: We are back for India Women's reply! The players of Pakistan Women are seen in a huddle near the boundary ropes. Smriti Mandhana and Sabbhineni Meghana will open the batting for India Women. Sadia Iqbal comes to bowl. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, this should be an interesting contest. Pakistan Women will look to grab some early wickets and India Women will look to put on a solid opening stand. Who will get over the line in this fierce rivalry? To find out, do join us for the second essay in a short while.

India Women were excellent with the ball at the start. Deepti Sharma ran havoc during the Powerplay and bagged two quick wickets. They struggled a lot to keep going post that and couldn't get any of the wickets as Bismah Marood and Nida Dar stiched a great partnership. Renuka Singh managed to get Bismah Maroof in the 17th over and they got momentum again in the game. Deepti Sharma ended with three wickets, while Pooja Vastrakar got two.

So, Pakistan Women end with a par total, after a sluggish start. They struggled a bit in the start with the blade. They lost a wicket in the fifth over and two more in quick successions in the sixth over. Inside the Powerplay, they were 33 for 3. Their skipper, Bismah Maroof and Nida Dar took off well after that and kept the scoreboard ticking. Pakistan lost their skipper in the 17th over but Nida Dar scored a half-century and took Pakistan Women over the 135-mark! This is the highest total Pakistan Women have ever scored against India Women.
A single to end the innings! A yorker now, around middle and off, Nida Dar does well to dig it out towards long on for a single. Pakistan Women end at 137 for 6!
A fuller ball, around middle and off. Tuba Hassan sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Tuba Hassan is the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! Deepti Sharma grabs her third wicket now and it's Ayesha Naseem who has to depart! A low full toss, around middle. Ayesha Naseem steps down the pitch and heaves this one towards deep mid-wicket. The ball goes more off the inner half of the bat and towards the fielder there. Jemimah Rodrigues pouches it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Jemimah Rodrigues b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller one and on off, Nida Dar flicks it to mid-wicket for one more.
Fuller one on off, Ayesha Naseem drills it to long on for one.
FOUR! Up and over! A fuller ball, around off. Ayesha Naseem steps down the pitch and tonks it down the ground for a boundary.
Outside off, fuller ball. Nida Dar sweeps it towards square leg for a brace.
An opportunity missed! A shorter length ball, around middle and off. Ayesha Naseem steps down the pitch and misses her pull. Shafali Verma fails to pouch the ball as well. A single take in the end.
A fuller ball, around middle, Nida Dar miscues her heave towards long on for a single.
A fuller ball, around middle, Nida Dar sweeps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Another short one, outside off, Nida Dar cuts it towards point. Not in the gap though!
Shorter one, outside off. Ayesha Naseem knocks it down to long off, off the back foot for a single.
A fuller ball, around middle. Ayesha Naseem drills it straight back towards the bowler. The ball deflects off the tumps and goes towards mid off. A single taken!
A slower ball, outside off. Nida Dar cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
Another length delivery, outside off. Ayesha Naseem lifts this one towards long off. Only a single.

OUT! TAKEN! A stunning catch from Sabbhineni Meghana! She made a tough catch look very easy here! Pooja Vastrakar gets rid of Aliya Riaz now and Pakistan Women have lost half their side. A length ball, around middle and off.  Aliya Riaz miscues her lofted shot in front of long on. Sabbhineni Meghana at long on run forward, puts in a dive and takes a terrific catch.  Ayesha Naseem is the new batter.
Commentary.Howout: c Sabbhineni Meghana b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Edgy runs! That should have stopped but an important boundary for Pakistan Women! A good-length delivery, outside off. Aliya Riaz looks to pull this one away, but the ball goes off the under edge towards the keeper. Shafali Verma (sub) fails to stop the ball and it rolls away towards fine leg for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, angling away, width on offer now. Aliya Riaz stays in her crease and looks to cut this one away but she fails to get any bat on it.
Fuller ball, outside off, slower through the air. Aliya Riaz dances down the pitch and pushes it towards long off for a run.
A fuller ball, around middle. Aliya Riaz works it away towards mid-wicket. No run there!

Shorter ball, outside off. Nida Dar pushes it off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single. That brings up her fifty! He 6th T20I half-century. What a crucial knock this has been. She will want to stick around till the end and take her side to a healthy total.
Tossed up, spinning away, outside off. Nida Dar once sweeps this one against the turn towards deep square leg for a brace.
Shorter one now, outside off, turning away. Aliya Riaz rocks back and cuts it towards point for another run.
A loopy ball, full, spinning away, outside off. Nida Dar sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. Only a single.
Outside off, fuller ball. Nida Dar strokes it towards mid off for a quick single. Nida Dar retains the strike here.
A fuller ball, around middle. Aliya Riaz knocks it down to long on for a single.
Aliya Riaz is the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! Renuka Singh finally breaks this stand! A good knock from the skipper comes to an end. A fuller ball, slower one, outside off. Bismah Maroof looks to scoop this one over short fine leg. But she checks her shot, changes her mind at the end and ends up chipping it towards short third man. Rajeshwari Gayakwad takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Rajeshwari Gayakwad b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Well bowled! A yorker-length delivery, outside off. Bismah Maroof digs this one out towards cover. A dot now!
Another low dipping full toss, outside off. Nida Dar gets low and swipes it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A low full toss, around middle. Bismah Maroof makes room and knocks it down to mid off for a quick single.
Flighted up, on off. Bismah Maroof flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Fuller one this time, this is pushed to covers for one.
FOUR! Tossed up on middle, Nida Dar moves forward and lofts it over long on for a boundary!
Tossed up, around off. Bismah Maroof flicks it to square leg for one.
Fuller one this time, Nida Dar eases it to covers for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Bismah Maroof pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
Bowls it outside off, Bismah Maroof drives it to covers for one.
On off, this is pushed towards the mid off fielder.
Wide! This one lands outside leg, Bismah Maroof leaves it alone.
FOUR! A yorker and outside off, Bismah Maroof uses the pace of the ball and helps it through third man for a boundary!
Full toss this time, outside off. Nida Dar slaps it to point for one.
On off again, Bismah Maroof flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off, Nida Dar lofts it but doesn't get the power right. The ball goes up in the air and lands safely at deep mid-wicket. They cross.
Length and outside off, Bismah Maroof looks to pull it but misses.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Fuller and on off, Bismah Maroof swivels and pulls it past backward square leg for a boundary!
Fuller and on off, this is pushed towards mid off for one.
FOUR! One bounce and over the ropes. Fuller and on off, Nida Dar drills it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Fuller one and on off, Bismah Maroof flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
On a length and just outside off, slower too. Bismah Maroof looks to play at it but misses.

Slight halt! Richa Ghosh seems uncomfortable. It's very hot and humid in Sylhet and she seems to be having a sunstroke. The physio is out there! Richa Ghosh is walking off the field and Shafali Verma will keep wickets for now.
SIX! Up and over! Fuller and on off, Nida Dar dances down the track and lofts it over long on for a maximum.
On off, this is pushed towards mid off for one.
Flights ball, outside off, Maroof drills that one, away to point for a brace.
Fuller and on off, Nida Dar sweeps it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Excellent timing on this! Tossed up, on off. Nida Dar moves forward and slogs it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up on leg, Bismah Maroof sweeps it to short fine leg for one.
Shorter one on off, Nida Dar lets it go.
Length again, around off. Bismah Maroof pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
Good length, on off. Bismah Maroof eases it to covers. Dot.
Slightly shorter and on off, Nida Dar punches it to covers for one.
On a length and on off with some extra bounce, Bismah Maroof looks to tap it but gets a slight edge towards third man. They cross.
On a length and on off, Bismah Maroof defends it to point.

Drinks! India Women started off well and bagged some early wickets inside the Powerplay, to put some early pressure on the opposition. Deepti Sharma was the one who put India Women in the driving seat. But the pair of Bismah Maroof and Nida Dar have done well to regain some sort of control. They will look to carry on the same way.

A back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Nida Dar rocks back and slashes it towards backward point. A misfield there allows the batters to take two runs. Pakistan Women are 61 for 3 at the halfway stage.
Tossed up, full in length, around off. Nida Dar prods forward and plays it back to the bowler.
Spinning away, attacking the stumps, a shortish ball. Nida Dar makes room and cuts it towards point. Not in the gap though.
FOUR! Up and over! A fuller one again, around middle. Nida Dar dances down the pitch and lofts it over the leaping fielder at mid on for a boundary.
Pitched up, around middle, looped up as well. Bismah Maroof skips down the pitch and knocks it down to long off for a single.
Floats this one up again, full, outside off. Nida Dar takes a big stride forward and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Outside off, fuller ball, slower. Nida Dar dabs it towards point and takes a single. She retains the strike.
FOUR! Nicely done! A top shot from Nida Dar. Loopy ball, full, around middle. Nida Dar gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Spinning into the left-hander, a short ball, around middle. Bismah Maroof nudges it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses this one up, full and on the pads. Nida Dar sweeps it towards short fine leg. Only a single.
Quicker now, flatter ball as well, around middle and leg. Bismah Maroof tucks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Radha Yadav starts off with a fuller ball, outside off. Bismah Maroof pushes it towards cover off the front foot for a single.
Radha Yadav comes into the attack.
Outside off, a fuller ball. Bismah Maroof leans in and dabs it towards point for a quick single.

A huge shout for LBW, but the finger stays down! A short one, spinning in, this one stays low as well. Bismah Maroof rocks back and looks to block this one but she misses and gets hit on her pads. That looked Out! She is very lucky to survive this one.
Back to 'round the wicket for the right-hander, a fuller ball, outside off. Nida Dar pushes it towards cover for a single.
Short ball, outside off. Bismah Maroof taps it towards point for a single.

MISFIELD by the skipper! A fuller one from over the wicket now, outside off. Bismah Maroof drives it towards mid off and runs across to the other end. Harmanpreet Kaur fails to stop the ball and the batters take another run.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad begins with a loopy ball, spinning away, outside off, Nida Dar pushes it off the front foot through cover. Only a single.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes into the atatck.
Full again, outside off, flighted delivery. Nida Dar strides forward and drives it through cover for a single.
Fuller one this time, tossed up and outside off. Nida Dar presses forward and looks to drive. But the ball goes off the outside edge towards short third man for a single.
Drfitng in, around middle and off, short in length. Bismah Maroof taps it through point. A single taken!
Slower through the air, pulls her length back now, the line is outside off. Nida Dar pushes it off the back foot through cover for another run.
Tosses it up again, full in length, around middle. Bismah Maroof sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Begins with a loopy one, full, around middle. Bismah Maroof leans in and blocks it out.
Nida Dar is the new batter. Dayalan Hemalatha comes into the attack.

OUT! LBW! Another wicket in the over for Deepti Sharma! The ploy of giving Deepti Sharma her third over in a row has done wonders for India Women. Tosses this one up, serves it full, around middle, straight ball this time. Omaima Sohail gets down on her knee and tries to sweep this one but she misses and gets hit on her pads. A huge shout for LBW, and the umpires agrees!
Outside off, short in length. Omaima Sohail looks to block this one but she gets beaten on the outside edge.
Omaima Sohail walks in.

OUT! STUMPED! Two wickets in two overs for India Women! Deepti Sharma sends back the other opener, Muneeba Ali now! This is beautiful bowling from the off-spinner! She sticks to bowling it wide of off, fuller in length, spinning away. Muneeba Ali shimmies down the pitch and swings her bat across the line, but she misses. Richa Ghosh collects the ball and whips the bails off.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Width on offer again, short. Bismah Maroof cuts it towards backward point and rotates the strike!
TWO WIDES! Slightly short again, wide of off again. Muneeba Ali shuffles across and leaves it alone. Richa Ghosh fails to stop the ball as well. The batters cross ends. Wide given!
Shorter ball, spinning away, wide of off. Muneeba Ali chops it towards cover-point. No run there!
Tosses this one up, slower through the air, full and outside off. Muneeba Ali gets down on her knee and sweeps it gently through square leg. Two taken.
Slightly shorter and on off, Muneeba Ali pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Good length again, on off. Bismah Maroof flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
On a length and on off, Bismah Maroof defends it soldily.
The skipper of Pakistan Women, Bismah Maroof comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Pooja Vastrakar strikes in her very first over. This one lands on a length and outside off and nips away a touch. Sidra Ameen looks to cut this one but misses and gets the slightest of the edge. Richa Ghosh behind the stumps pouches it safely. India Women have their first breakthrough!
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on off, Sidra Ameen defends it solidly.
Slightly shorter and on off, Muneeba Ali pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Pooja Vastrakar comes into the attack. She replaces Renuka Singh.
Slightly shorter this time, Muneeba Ali punches it to covers for one.
Fuller and on off, Sidra Ameen flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Bowls it wide outside off, Sidra Ameen plays a reverse sweep to third man for a brace.
Outside off with a hint of turn, Sidra Ameen looks to play at it but misses.
Tossed up on off, slower too. Muneeba Ali slaps it to deep covers for one.
FOUR! Fuller and on off, Muneeba Ali drills it between mid on and mid-wicket for a boundary!
Bowls it outside off, Sidra Ameen looks to cut it but misses. A dot to end with.
Fuller and on off, Muneeba Ali nudges it to the left of mid on for one.
Fuller and on off, Muneeba Ali drills it but finds the fielder at mid off.
Length again, around off. Sidra Ameen eases it to covers for one.
FOUR! On a length and on off, Sidra Ameen hangs back and cuts it through point for a boundary. Excellent shot!
Fuller one on middle, Sidra Ameen defends it solidly.
Bowls it outside off angling it away, Muneeba Ali looks to slap it but misses.
Fuller and outside off, Muneeba Ali taps it to extra cover for a brace.
Slightly shorter, on off. Sidra Ameen punches it to covers for one.
Fuller and outside off, Muneeba Ali moves forward and slices it to covers. The ball goes up in the air and falls safely. They collect one. Close!
Bowls it outside off, Muneeba Ali slaps it but finds the fielder at point.
Tossed up, on off. Sidra Ameen eases it to covers for one.
Deepti Sharma will bowl from the other end.
Serves it fuller, Sidra Ameen taps it to covers and scampers for a single.
On a length and outside off angling it away, Sidra Ameen looks to defend it but misses.
On a length with some extra bounce. Sidra Ameen guides it to short third man. The fielder stops it diving to her left. Dot.
Fuller one this time, Muneeba Ali eases it to cover for one.
This one lands on off, Muneeba Ali defends it to mid off.
Good length again, on off. Muneeba Ali steers it through point. The fielder chases it well. They collect a couple.
Starts with a length ball wide outside off, Muneeba Ali lets it go. Wide called.

We are all ready for one of the greatest battles in the sport! It's India versus Pakistan. The umpires have made their way out in the middle. India Women have taken their field positions as well. Muneeba Ali and Sidra Ameen will open the batting for Pakistan Women. Renuka Singh will begin with the ball. Let's play!

PITCH REPORT - Athar Ali Khan is pitch side. He says that the pitch looks good for batting. It is very dry and it will assist the spinners a bit and tends to get dryer after on which will assist the spinners more in the end. Adds that overall a very good wicket for batting.

Harmanpreet Kaur the captain of India Women says that they wanted to bowl anyways and that this game is important. Adds that they have won all the matches while batting so they wanted to change it. Further says that they wanted to see how their bowlers do and how the team performs while chasing. Ends by saying that they have two changes in the team.

Bismah Maroof the captain of Pakistan Women says that they will bat first, it looks like a decent wicket. Adds that they did not have a good game against Thailand, but they are looking to rectify their errors. Informs that they have made two changes to their side.

Pakistan Women (Playing XI) - Sidra Ameen, Muneeba Ali (WK), Bismah Maroof (C), Omaima Sohail, Nida Dar, Aliya Riaz, Ayesha Naseem, Sadia Iqbal (In for Kainat Imtiaz), Tuba Hassan, Aiman Anwer (In for Diana Baig), Nashra Sandhu.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Sabbhineni Meghana, Jemimah Rodrigues,  Harmanpreet Kaur (C) (In for Kiran Navgire), Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (WK), Dayalan Hemalatha, Pooja Vastrakar, Renuka Singh, Radha Yadav (In for Sneh Rana), Rajeshwari Gayakwad.
TOSS - Pakistan Women have won the toss and opted to BAT first.
